sharedResearch.boundary: Existing joint inquiry/writing is a component. Attributed scientific contributions and causal comparison remain explicitly assessed; the generic research card alone does not certify the source.

physicalDesigns.boundary: Retain real physical design, actual comparison and purposeful retest. Screen/paper recognition does not replace it; source-specific application is not whole-topic mastery.

notReused: The existing rainforest ecological-knowledge claim is not an authenticated account of these communities.
No community, nationality, person or grade-specific mastery clone is created.

wholeClaimBoundary: All authored claims/guides, old contexts, age intervals and dependencies remain exact. Only six source-component associations are appended to the existing shared-research contexts. No biography repertoire, cultural identity inference, automatic mastery transfer or learner operation.
programmeBoundary: This prepared portfolio supplies assessable applications and contribution analysis; repeated learning in varied contexts remains part of delivery. It does not recertify every historical science Full judgment.
